evidence.quote: if (input.end <= input.start) throw new DomainError(400, "end must be after start");

rules.statement: A club booking's end time must be later than its start time.
rules.subject: club booking end time

evidence.quote: if (!AREAS.includes(input.area)) throw new DomainError(400, "area must be whole, half-a or half-b");

rules.statement: A club booking must be for the whole rink or one of its two halves (half-a or half-b).
rules.subject: club booking area

evidence.quote: if (clash) throw new DomainError(409, "overlaps another club booking");

rules.statement: A club booking cannot overlap in time with another club booking on the same date that uses any of the same rink halves.
rules.subject: club booking time slot and rink area

rules.statement: The monthly club invoice charges every booked hour in the month at the club hourly rate, whether the whole rink or half was booked, with the total rounded to the nearest cent.
rules.subject: monthly club invoice total
